findings: Writers confirm comma joining without escaping for processed paths, selected buckets and favorites. Reader/writer pair therefore cannot roundtrip comma-containing paths; prior concern is now supported on both sides.

Include/exclude scope readers also split comma-separated strings and invalid scope enum falls back to ALL_FILES. Combined with service validation, malformed saved scope can broaden discovery; writers remain later in file.

Path updates use DataStore.edit transactions, avoiding the simple separate-read lost-update pattern identified in SharedPreferences hidden-group handling. Serialization ambiguity remains independent of transaction safety.
removeProcessedMediaPathsInFolder compares exact parent strings, removing direct children only; it does not remove descendants recursively. Whether UI promises recursive forgetting remains unread.

Similarity defaults BALANCED; screenshot conversion defaults JPEG90 and delete-original false. Default video speed reads arbitrary float without finite/positive bounds here; downstream validation remains unread.
